"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"山东平度老兵维权升级为暴力流血事件引发关注。中国央视公布的画面显示，维权老兵手持木棍围攻军警。北京时间12月9日，中国央视公布一段视频显示，维权老兵被指进行非法游行、示威，甚至暴力袭警、打砸车辆，导致34名军警受伤。上述事件发生在今年的10月4日至7日。目前，山东警方以涉嫌妨害公务罪、故意伤害罪、聚众扰乱公共场所秩序罪、寻衅滋事罪等逮捕10人。中国公安部官微“公安部打四黑除四害”在10日发声称，军人的荣光不容被亵渎，法治的权威不容被损害，和谐社会不容被破坏。官微借重庆官民之口呼吁民众与这些人划清界限。 转文中，重庆的退役军人均表示，“退伍不褪色，转业不转志，永葆军人对党对人民对祖国忠诚本色。”"}]}]}]},{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"5c729787-b9e8-4fb7-86c0-191ee58f62c2","nodeId":"4ff91412f5534b6f9204831a66b54be3"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-bb8ccbbc-c536-435b-9229-6078224d158b","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"6b00dffbfae54bcc8d166ef024322dd0"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"0db51f0f-5d44-4893-83ca-465a18b831c0","nodeId":"c66c96ca176b495e9a6e4e06393a6422"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"【大纪元2015年08月20日讯】（大纪元记者陈静慧综合报导）8月19日上午，数百名越战老兵因为补助被克扣到广东省阳江市政府维权，与大量警察及政府人员爆发激烈冲突。双方呐喊着互掷石块、水瓶、棍棒等，多人头破血流，浑身是血，场面极其混乱。冲突致20多名老兵受伤入院。20日，大陆多省市老兵将赶到阳江声援，举行大规模游行示威，事态进一步扩大。据535天网得到的消息，8月19日上午9时余至下午15时左右，广东省阳江市数百名参战老兵到阳江市政府上访，要求落实多年来未落实的政策。中午13时左右，阳江市政府派出大量警察和维稳人员殴打参战老兵，致20多名老兵受伤。"}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"collapse","attrs":{"active":false,"dataDiffId":"e6ee0c5e-cd55-4691-8d08-5d0d2ffd3b25","id":"b95ace2db0ed4793b9286f16e3c50e7a","nodeId":"9bf70f03079d4865b9e0af4a6c8c038c"},"content":[{"type":"collapse_title","attrs":{"align":"","nodeId":"c2f3d9ffff3e441bb7501c18b6ec59d1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"案例"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"5187b549e7e046a6ba7af9fc21048356"},"content":[{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"60c877e3-329f-41e3-8eb2-bcd4d21bb1e6","nodeId":"4626de5a578b4e00af64a1d86b322e99"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-07579aa2-318d-4f87-b180-56cf38e6cf75","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"63e730de9fa04905863b07dc56713aa2"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c3f6ab25-9282-4399-a476-ce5daffeab69","nodeId":"94203e99089743cd92f03a8fcc5f6765"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"游行示威"}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs" "},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"泽良律师"},{"type":"text","text":"锁定两大争议焦点，"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"从事实与法律层面"},{"type":"text","text":"进行抗辩。首先，交警已结合监控、现场勘查完整还原事故，短暂离开并未造成事故事实无法查清，不满足保险拒赔适用条件。其次，案涉保险为微信线上投保，保险公司未交付完整商业险条款，投保单未载明逃逸免责内容，也未对免责事项作出高亮提示，口头告知无留存证据，依据保险法相关规定，逃逸免责条款不产生法律效力。 一审法院采纳全部代理意见，认定保险公司应当承担商业险赔付责任。保险公司不服提起上诉，泽良律师继续巩固证据、提交答辩，二审驳回上诉维持原判。经持续跟进督办，100万商业三者险、用人单位赔付21万余元全部到账，叠加交强险，家属累计获赔140.97万元。本案一、二审连续胜诉，成功打破保险拒赔壁垒，充分维护受害方的合法权益。"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-25021060-9587-49da-97e9-791f1636d473","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"32e30af7601c452d972eb14e0178602e"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"73c920d5-ac49-40b8-8906-134c57cefe36","nodeId":"1a278d96561e4313814e6364b2b51ede"},"content":[{"type":"image","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/254138531681?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","small":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/254137854458?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","origin":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/254135591104?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","mss":"","name":"","title":null,"width":276,"height":600,"link":null,"border":false,"isFullWidth":false,"crop":null,"nodeId":"8ba3fcd80115437ca416094f8fd85674"}}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"76b312bb-8852-4dee-a63a-82d1dad57b42","nodeId":"8aa986d21cc54df7951144918eb50f08"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"教育普法宣传/公共服务警示："}]},{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"86cccba0-5b5c-456d-ad78-bdac69541f1e","nodeId":"1045b673900a4c61a9434d5548b90e07"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-8221fff2-3733-4d39-bfed-b5696a04778c","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"aa9d3fb9a2d74e8ba043cf79801e0179"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f5ce4bdb-5223-4996-8c01-56e3e4c1e679","nodeId":"4bb0928d6d4645deaac432591b350096"},"content":[{"type":"image","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/254138303717?&contentType=1&isNewContent=false","small":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/254134982839? دۆلەت，拉丁维吾尔文：Örkesh Dölet），维吾尔族异见人士与王丹、柴玲等同为八九学运的学生领袖，被中华人民共和国政府通缉。1989年4月21日，吾尔开希宣布成立“北京师范大学学生自治会”及“北京市临学联”并自任主席。当晚，在北大筹委会及清华学生的推动下，在北京师范大学举办“誓师大会”，有超过六万人参与[11]。当夜，上述数万学生前往天安门广场，在人民大会堂会场外参与次日的胡耀邦追悼会。25日，与刘刚、王丹、王超华、熊焱等人将北京临时学联改名为“北京高校学生自治联合会”简称“北高联”。北高联随即成为继北大筹委会之后的八九学生运动的主要组织。吾尔开希担任该组织第二任主席。自此，吾尔开希成为天安门学生运动主要学生领袖。4月29日，中国政府当局组织的与学生代表的对话中，吾尔开希要求以北高联主席身份参与，在进入会场之前被当局阻止，当晚与王丹在香格里拉饭店召开记者招待会，自称被中共便衣跟踪，不再参与北高联会议，二人便被学运组织边缘化。5月13日，吾尔开希便与王丹等6人发起绝食。"}]}]}]},{"type":"table_row","attrs":{"dataRowDiffId":"14ac9e3f-c1bf-4336-bd73-5ffde332109d","nodeId":"eb7eee971c6c48e0ba4d7eee35b454d0"},"content":[{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[120],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"41fc14e2-aaca-4b9c-88a3-fdfae84872de","nodeId":"89082ee160a24129ad767564bab6b02b"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f6559a0b-6f42-42dc-99b9-dfc151166c39","nodeId":"5348507b43ac408c8c2221bb961da824"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"07372453-8a1e-4c98-8ed4-d987afb117f3","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-cn/%E5%91%A8%E9%94%8B%E9%94%81","title":"周锋锁","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"b47e229439a74940983f5d1c694fe9b3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"周锋锁"}]}]}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[227],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"1c61b0e8-de4e-4d04-9d7f-0a2eb1d98e06","nodeId":"41a86aaaa4bf4ab6ace40daac6310f6d"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"069130fd-3fbb-4251-bccb-77756df58aa1","nodeId":"3f13e6f2dd2a4f22900f4288866e90fc"},"content":[{"type":"image","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/237960691149?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","small":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/237962542359?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","origin":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/237963377220?contentType=1&isNewContent=false"," "content":[{"type":"text","text":"六四事件中的天安门绝食始于1989年5月13日。据学生表示，他们愿意冒着生命危险来引起政府的关注。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"676022f7-10f1-40ed-8455-77cd0796c562","nodeId":"f579022dd84e4178bab95fcd64b396db"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"5月15日，学生正式成立绝食抗议委员会，以组织协调广场内的行动。到5月16日，共有3,100名绝食抗议者。[4]广场上昏厥的学生随时可以得到救护车和医疗帮助。允许本地和外国媒体报道学生抗议活动。北京市对学生绝食的支持导致5月16日至5月18日发生大规模抗议活动，超过一百万人参加了北京市的抗议活动，包括工人，青年，老人和其他市民。绝食于5月19日结束。"}]}]}]},{"type":"table_row","attrs":{"dataRowDiffId":"5da9144e-6cdb-4160-ae40-7dd53e9d7eba","nodeId":"6e12ae57b1a14d0c972ff6078c11e90d"},"content":[{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[120],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"76f71bd5-c03d-4167-a84a-8867e81e3d0b","nodeId":"4ac74fa6fa5d497d9c36a94081dfb2ae"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"7e65877c-0b18-4b28-b03c-779dba7fd829","nodeId":"5846863f42f94af5a56c63c5a86558cd"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"3844d1e0-8a90-4fae-8813-5dd917eece12","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%85%A8%E7%90%83%E8%8F%AF%E4%BA%BA%E5%A4%A7%E9%81%8A%E8%A1%8C","title":"全球华人大游行","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"f947ac5101a048c7b1fcda235dbc0ca6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"全球华人大游行"}]},{"type":"text","text":"（五二八大游行）"}]}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[580],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"75851f25-abee-48af-bd9d-1f8109558779","nodeId":"76659e1d081a48eeab784c811a37b7f9"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"2a2bb66c-1484-4f6f-9c9c-11dd7ef4ad34","nodeId":"4d1ebc0a1e544736b914b2152d4e324c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"又称五二八大游行，是正值八九民运时一场于1989年5月28日（星期日）举行的全球性游行活动，接续前一天周六在香港举行的民主歌声献中华，以声援在北京天安门广场抗议的学生。北京的学生为纪念胡耀邦逝世，同时争取民主、反贪腐、反贫富悬殊等目的，呼吁全球华人在当日串连游行。"}]}]}]},{"type":"table_row","attrs":{"dataRowDiffId":"49784d11-103e-41a9-9502-e7 特别那一组12尊铜像，记忆中是在南湖饭店的对面不远处，早饭后和同事散步经常去看看，是2001年（建党80周年）落成的，雕像里除了毛泽东、董必武等一大代表，还有会务工作者王会悟，她就是提议把会议转移到南湖的人，雕塑还原了当年场景。早些年的时候，这里只是湖边一组雕塑，没有介绍说明；近些年经过改造提升，立起了旧址石碑，（狮子会渡口）配全历史说明，把这条从火车站到渡口、再登船赴南湖的完整历史路线，清晰展现出来了，解了我二十多年疑惑，游客走到这里，就能读懂这段历史脉络\\\\n 1921年，代表们从上海坐火车抵达嘉兴火车站，图四开始，出站之后步行走到狮子汇渡口，在这里坐上摆渡船，先到湖心岛烟雨楼，再换乘那艘红船，在船上开完了中共一大最后的会议，宣告中国共产党诞生 。"}]},{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"dce08595-7e42-43ac-ae28-0e0c1c3bafb4","nodeId":"d4029b78cb3e4a28a1d58ca3f1f8b0c8"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-f426d351-354f-46e8-9f61-8e0b40e1e487","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"03e73089be524a4294e1a7919f7518cc"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"5d4efe53-731b-4fa7-b209-7057a6a09042","nodeId":"6dcb50d4e8f44e4b810ab0190d4446ba"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"博物馆"}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"7076587b-9951-480d-b1bd-c34debdd975d","nodeId":"607f4aa748474856ab94a58c45fbf37e"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"欢迎来到中共一大"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"博物馆"},{"type":"text","text":"，现在我们看到的这艘红船，就是我党第一次全国代表大会时的场所，回望1921年在7月24日举行第二次会议，各地代表报告本地区党团组织的状况和工作进程，并交流了经验体会。25、26日休会，用于起草党的纲领和今后工作计划。27、28和29日三天，分别举行三次会议，集中议论此前起草的纲领和决议。讨论认真热烈，大家各抒己见，既有统一的认识，又在某些问题引起争论，会议未作出决定。"}]},{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"2281fe54-e770-4816-a136-ebb573ca585d","nodeId":"61a3b1f60c4a43809b19cdea9d53e218"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-9a669164-4712-4558-bf46-ed591dd245b5","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"3146d951ce554a19b5209283bfe123c2"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ed5067fb-0eec-47cd-b81d-7f1fa6fdf9bc","nodeId":"eb7513e5b13843daa9990a3e809372ab"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"党建文化宣传墙"}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"9de4cc34-deae-4545-8d07-e93445f9fd33","nodeId":"57f184e4ec3a4e39a4b6fddd33c3e279"},"content":[{"type":"image","attrs":{"src":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/265370361085?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","small":"https://km.sankuai.com/api/file/cdn/1625845476/265370361085?contentType=1&isNewContent=false","origin" 128)"}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6e6bad04-bc9f-44e4-b6ac-7a8563622b29","nodeId":"d4ee8628ba1448d2a18154c78f1ba42f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(一)反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f85bc644-4785-438c-bb90-383c91d3a4bf","nodeId":"c5a90525c7374679892578f700a6b5b7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"(二)危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"49b1f71a-a0c4-48b9-99d9-b66994a56269","nodeId":"b410d9e077bb49d58b7ef9ac18acb829"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"(三)损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"440c78af-155e-4639-9c4e-5fdff76d50f2","nodeId":"df4ed6a0ae8d4546a605e29f1bb84aa1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(四)歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"29e174fe-03d2-420a-a244-2fbc36c673b3","nodeId":"e6fbf18323c841eca96344007a4ddbf2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(五)宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ac6a5180-bde5-4c0a-814c-6b3e99381d94","nodeId":"cfd4152aeb1744d6a80004bb97a04f95"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(六)煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"de017b37-98ac-4f12-814a-35740ea9aa8d","nodeId":"8a41e2880c4e49798c4c50c790670564"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(七)破坏国家宗教政策，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"72331012-12ea-445c-8b25-9f311136035a","nodeId":"758763d28e6c4c47ab2024d34a5217df"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(八)散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"65f4a2bc-5904-47d2-a823-677b2ed5df2f","nodeId":"f3946b89fc3245cfb25615deae44e368"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(九)散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"d59dedeb-d352-4643-9900-bd3c3e70710e","nodeId":"cc26daa86ede4d0c9c7bca1b833e56f1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十)侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"5b0d2d4b-aeec-47d6-8663-e8a8d6496913","nodeId":"0c9707a64c244ecc9c1d35d304dd2c02"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十一)法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"24eb4ef5-07b6-40c5-812c-8551250632eb","nodeId":"f555044b1ae74777bfd21540b49562f0"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络信息内容生态治理规定"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a66d49d7-5483-458d-a3fd-a861afec547f","nodeId":"a74070d770ce42988cf83e1bb4f9a7ec"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"28d3cc1a-98e9-4dbc-bc3a-21b2af6d2c54","nodeId":"410e58ce17f048268209fa5117b53085"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f7b0e171-a25e-446a-b111-05e35453db2f","nodeId":"16501f8ff46b4c78b7382df026e87e49"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（二）危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"913296e7-fc01-4713-a644-1952e4f6b31b","nodeId":"114a83b6a9db4c5087507ca6c0625a8d"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（三）损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"81d68ce2-4eba-44ea-8eb4-4c15939c29d6","nodeId":"a7691660040f4b398595a84073a8759c"},"content":[{"typ ,"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）使用夸张标题，内容与标题严重不符的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"dd84fead-a45a-4ab9-bc5f-273c4b255f25","nodeId":"c927e2f544fc428e996f1ff74feeede2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）炒作绯闻、丑闻、劣迹等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"cf592345-5695-425d-9d8c-4fc42f3dc327","nodeId":"34452e165afa4762ba55bcf0c6b45cc1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）不当评述自然灾害、重大事故等灾难的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d8042631-b256-4dcf-9bbf-bdd3c0fda412","nodeId":"bf8a3fab5d714a8e9360884ac1d9dbc7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）带有性暗示、性挑逗等易使人产生性联想的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"36fb6d4b-7e8a-4c4c-9a4c-bbb6a86f5434","nodeId":"e628c3167fb9495fa8cdd91fe1165803"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）展现血腥、惊悚、残忍等致人身心不适的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4c7ea918-882a-467c-a6af-0250f55f59af","nodeId":"4e8e89610dc4409fbf92c7dabe814708"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动人群歧视、地域歧视等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a7e97893-98ff-4096-a2c1-4c95a4666edd","nodeId":"ce1ac780b7c44d25af0651727e66e091"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）宣扬低俗、庸俗、媚俗内容的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fa723d25-fdb0-4948-9205-f2b5e8d97c56","nodeId":"3b52159c694d46f195808409e7c97435"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）可能引发未成年人模仿不安全行为和违反社会公德行为、诱导未成年人不良嗜好等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"844a8103-f062-41bc-8051-d89bf35a8d49","nodeId":"b10f44bc7fd54eb8bb1051f4ec6793ea"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）其他对网络生态造成不良影响的内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a23bbdde-1bf1-4305-9ecd-58052d5bd9a3","nodeId":"ef5a4d1282ac4ae2999fa182dbcfff58"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"广告法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"45739cbb-b6ec-4dfa-ab54-67a524482a28","nodeId":"1609dc0a6c1e42e5a024998f034ea374"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"广告不得有下列情形："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"e262bcfa-dc11-4672-8a3e-c58373830967","nodeId":"623768d3fd544526a3f95abccd5c3ca4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）使用或者变相使用中华人民共和国的国旗、国歌、国徽，军旗、军歌、军徽；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"c0fae9ea-f948-4883-b96a-a5ce4bacc027","nodeId":"91834d60d95b4721b4e22627e5af5643"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）使用或者变相使用国家机关、国家机关工作人员的名义或者形象；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"2e160058-8fd4-4836-8ccf-0db7d95d712c","nodeId":"5172dd3e59754064b81810c294b4a157"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）使用“国家级”、“最高级”、“最佳”等用语；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f8e811d0-c6e4-41af-8f59-ce4eba216fee","nodeId":"d56921ef9d504ac4958d4c0c92f563fc"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（四）损害国家的尊严或者利益，泄露国家秘密；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"538537a9-1782-46af-8744-f2fb16b7fd56","nodeId":"1a81a06762214accbba668a527a808e6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）妨碍社会安定，损害社会公共利益；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"86954b3d-6d85-4b18-830b-61517d834f7e","nodeId":"d554385258804b259395caca0d2ae919"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）危害人身、财产安全，泄露个人隐私；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"82a480bb-4856-4d8d-b555-32663d295b43","nodeId":"e5548d556af345218289a117e3e01aed"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）妨碍社会公共秩序或者违背社会良好风尚；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"a087df4d-5b35-4b0f-9c10-f38d1bc1162c","nodeId":"86231f34324647cfa3b62155d2f2807e"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）含有淫秽、色情、赌博、迷信、恐怖、暴力的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"9f5f2cae-c219-4930-b988-efd36fdcecf7","nodeId":"51ca3f37871942ecbb998a8ff6f83bd8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）含有民族、种族、宗教、性别歧视的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6516d58b-7d2f-4c55-9757-cdc78bd9cf32","nodeId":"205f26ae042548aa98278e7971a884e3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）妨碍环境、自然资源或者文化遗产保护；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"82c130ac-10c7-4bd7-8634-7b4a2fe92031","nodeId":"684ff1d014474c0a8b718a8ea87fe4d1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）法律、行政法规规定禁止的其他情形。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e6d75060-538e-4a94-96f8-3865fcc0385a","nodeId":"671595cbf0274a808b739cfbe02a30e0"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"71520d8e-cb15-45ea-9e48-da5e9ec7381a","nodeId":"c6f71a6e07764e52a5e57871b5b4cc8f"}},{"type":"footnote_list","attrs":{"nodeId":"03737edb746b494093faaae5deb22c04"},"content":[{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"33ae03d6e10143ee8305429e654fe8c7","footnoteNodeId":"42b2cdd1c2974187aa62e63b8ca9e288"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"95abd444e3f140228d3356a595ec415c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"明显重伤：人员流血场景/担架搬运/正在进行抢救过程"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"cbb0e69f5698448abf0859216de91843","footnoteNodeId":"c45d0da7ede04bac9ac8a44ac8048cf3"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"977d8124c6194c69a53a4498dddac3ff"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"大规模严重结构性破坏：建筑坍塌/重大交通工具损毁/巨型设施事故"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"0d7d0ea58e194cc894dcb3702c149fa8","footnoteNodeId":"771c01c55b174ced830d9ea7899e3228"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"c9db5d34e48e4c7786a53db20638cc47"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公共场所严重混乱的：常见于灾害类事故，如人员无秩序恐慌四散奔逃/人群行为失控/持续高分贝的尖叫声、哭喊声等"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"4dae012ba003442fba62bf3f43e8a486","footnoteNodeId":"49af1a9d0aea40e5b4aedba1fbc3eb52"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"89cbd6b0cc1a4aaabff269509fd87752"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"违规影视画面特征："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"88adf6bd23b64b5c9ffa8e2a27f8e7ac"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"提及人与坦克进行对抗的"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":"ct-diff-id-8cd7bdd4-b64d-497b-890b-026420c11eee","nodeId":"c45ce3fc189942ca816f8a33bc509c37"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"提及天安门坦克信息的"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":"ct-diff-id-7b19a8c2-8aa8-4770-9726-b74acec36850","nodeId":"f7bd089ba1e54608a07af8501a41b2c3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"画面背景隐蔽处出现坦克人、民主女神、绝食抗议图像"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"9307a4a91772461988a90aa6a9b46eaf","footnoteNodeId":"78aa9247ecf3441c99935a7f84028198"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"2b41b843bada40cbafba4494c80f810d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"雅尔塔：雅尔塔会议（Yalta Conference）是由时任美国总统（富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福）、英国首相（温斯顿·丘吉尔）和苏联人民委员会主席（约瑟夫·维萨里奥诺维奇·斯大林）为代表的三个大国在第二次世界大战末期于1945年2月4日至2月11日之间在苏联黑海北部的克里米亚半岛的雅尔塔皇宫内举行的一次关于制定战后世界新秩序和列强利益分配问题的一次关键性的首脑会议。"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"85f4b1bca63845f2a7c66c98ec2fc776","footnoteNodeId":"5ef6c08226d34ac7b899c9c45dad9044"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"17fc3e51334c4b479340c44790d0ccad"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"线上主体：（画面占比≥1/4；抽帧：视频“疑似风险画面”或“视频抽帧”中仅出现1次，两者不叠加次数；无抽帧：视频时长≥1/3）"}]}]}]}]}
